nodes.label: Lov\'asz
nodes.statement: [Lov\'asz] The edges of a finite simple graph on \(n\) vertices can be partitioned into at most \(n/2\) paths and cycles.

nodes.label: Every finite simple graph on \(n\) vertices has an edge partition into paths…
nodes.statement: Every finite simple graph on \(n\) vertices has an edge partition into paths such that each vertex is an endpoint of at most two paths. In particular, the partition has at most \(n\) paths.
